verdict: not independent (uses NASS current-year planted acres and NASS current-year yield forecasts); also uses NASS crop condition and progress

inputs_used.starting value 'last': planted_asof x grain(t-1) / planted(t-1): planted_asof is NASS's latest in-season planted acres (June Acreage or later); for years before 2018 build_panel.py fills it with NASS's FINAL planted acres (stand_in=True): current-year NASS and a look-ahead
inputs_used.d_planted: log(planted_asof / planted(t-1)): NASS current-year planted acres
inputs_used.yield_shock: log(yield_asof / mean yield of 3 earlier years): NASS Aug-Nov grain yield forecast
inputs_used.d_poor, poor: cond_poor: NASS weekly crop condition (Tier B source)
inputs_used.late_plant: planted_may20: NASS weekly crop progress (Tier B source)
inputs_used.d_mature: mature_sep22: NASS weekly crop progress (Tier B source)
inputs_used.share_last: silage(t-1) / planted(t-1): NASS finals of t-1 (Tier A history)
